inputs.text: [excited] He was 3 meters long — like three 4-year-olds lying end to end! [amazed] He was as tall as a car — you'd have to look up! And he weighed 120 kilos — [serious] as heavy as a pig!
[gasps] Three kids lying down at once?
[chuckles] Three kids lying down, yes — [confident] end to end, that's his whole length.
